g.text: Shared Business Call Preparation and Execution
Agent adapter: direct bound target and business args.
CallTool: Skill-scoped name and args after outer validation.
Parameter errors include the same trusted definition [P].
Unknown target and invalid schema keep separate errors.
Preparation is side-effect free and uses no execution credentials.
Confirmation and execution share one immutable snapshot [P].
Recovery content and isError=true survive normalization
The model corrects args in a new call; no automatic replay.
